_note: Config blob per CLAUDE.md S4: ranking weights live in versioned config files, never hardcoded. The runner (experiments/bottomup/ranking_v1.py) reads every knob from this file. Editing this file after the run invalidates the result; make a v2.

engine._note: arm A is the pre-committed primary of component-model-multipos-precommit.md S4. Arms D/E are post-hoc by their own source comment and are excluded. Lagged-YPC volume override is excluded: unregistered.

def_note: DEF is a starting slot in this league with zero coverage in nfl.db. v1 emits no DEF ranking. Blank with a note; no fabricated number.

table_stakes.rule: only pre-committed feature blocks enter v1

tier0_5_depth_chart.reason: arms D/E are post-hoc (pos_features.py:37-41) and measured NULL on ranking

lagged_ypc_rb_volume.reason: post-hoc winner from factor batch 6; no registration exists in docs/preregistration/

rookies.label: consensus_fallback
rookies.definition: entry == 'rookie' -- no prior NFL season in the panel
rookies._note: Rookie draft capital is an eliminated edge channel. v1 holds no opinion on rookies; on rookie rows v1 equals the crowd it is compared against, contributing zero differential information in either direction.
rookies._amended_2026-07-31_before_first_run: Was 'a + b*ln(consensus_positional_rank)' fitted on strictly prior seasons. Replaced with rank-space pinning BEFORE any v1 number was computed (git history is the proof). Three reasons, all pre-run: (1) pinning delivers the stated intent exactly -- a rookie sits at its consensus slot -- where the curve only approximated it; (2) it removes a fitted object and therefore a look-ahead surface; (3) the curve cannot be fitted for the first panel-M season (2018 has no prior FFC season), which would have needed a special case invented after seeing which seasons broke.

cross_positional._note: The per-position rank-correlation endpoint is blind to this channel. It is in the config for completeness and must not be claimed as tested.

mde_rule.contrast: b1_market_adp - b3w_wavg_ppg (panel M); b2_expert_ecr - b3w_wavg_ppg (panel E)
mde_rule.action_if_exceeded: declare CANNOT ANSWER at that position, not NULL

decision_thresholds.edge: CI lower bound > 0 against both crowds
decision_thresholds.loses: CI upper bound < 0, or delta < -0.02 with CI containing 0
